text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the St. Lite Kinen, precursor to the Kikuka Sho. The day we've been waiting for since spring has finally come.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oho, your weight, Cafe… It's increased quite a lot since spring…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But what do we have here? Heh-heh, there's nothing supernatural about an increase so tangible…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, deep down inside, my body feels… different from before.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The strange squirming has gone away… and I feel like… my body is truly mine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I get the impression we've weathered a very strange storm…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If I can maintain this condition…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And overcome this next hurdle… Perhaps I could take on the Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't answer right away. Too many aspects of her health are still shrouded in mystery.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh, discussing the results of the experiment before you've conducted it? What nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Let's just see how you do on the turf. I wonder what color we can expect your litmus paper to turn, Cafe?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to believe it'll be a bright color. Today's the day to break free from this unseen quagmire bogging us down.
